correctness.rationale: In the orthonormal monomial basis the rows become a_k*zeta_j^k/sqrt(S_0) and k*a_k*zeta_j^k/sqrt(S_2) after unit-modulus scaling of the ordinary derivative rows. Factoring columns and rows out of the confluent Vandermonde gives the eighth power of each pairwise angular distance. Hadamard equality forces the first n-1 node power sums to vanish, so Newton identities give precisely the regular n-gon. The value comparator has the analogous regular 2n-gon equality case. The log-radius derivatives are governed by the degree means, each strictly increasing by its positive variance; their endpoint means bracket the desired roots. A unitary DFT in each set of rows pairs columns j and j+n, including the j=0 block. Near t=n the lost Poisson tails, also with each fixed degree-moment factor, are exponentially small. Thus the stationarity means are mu_0=t+O(exp(-cn)) and mu_2=t+2-1/(t+1)+O(exp(-cn)); this gives the stated two radii. At t_V the exact same-radius quotient times 4^n tends to 1 since S_2/S_0=n^2-1/4+o(1). At t=t_V+s the Hermite log-derivative tends uniformly for bounded s to -2-2s; integrating to s=t_H-t_V tending to -1 gives a gain of 1 in log determinant, hence factor e. The limit is for det(M* M) and under separate finite-space row normalization on one circle, not a condition-number or unrestricted planar result.
correctness.reproduction: With freshly constructed normalized value and derivative matrices the maximum tested relative determinant error was 1.6e-15 at regular nodes for n=2,3,5 and 1.1e-15 at a nonuniform n=4 configuration; direct Gram and DFT-block eigenvalues agreed to absolute 1.4e-15 at the regular test nodes. To replay the radial sweep, form log weights k*log(t)-lgamma(k+1) for k=0,...,2n-1, compute ordinary and k^2-weighted degree means, bisect each monotone stationarity equation, then subtract the two closed-form log determinants and add n*log(4) before exponentiating. Scaled ratios for n=2,10,40,80,160 were 2.762824907510, 2.731849736248, 2.723956443602, 2.721115558493, 2.719698056962; the n=160 t_H and t_V were 158.503134734630 and 159.500000000000. The frozen script was inspected, not executed. Finite runs corroborate but do not establish the asymptotics.

value.rationale: The comparison holds measurement count and row norms fixed while changing co-location, so the exponential determinant loss answers a concrete finite sampling design question. The full block spectrum also enables follow-up analysis without claiming that the determinant optimizer minimizes conditioning.
